title: ARGO Recalls ARGO Xplorer All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Incorrectly installed check valves and vent hoses can lead to fuel overflow, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500 (In addition, about 1,670 in Canada).

title: Emporia Recalls North America Smart Plugs Due to Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The recalled smart plugs are not adequately grounded and can pose an electric shock to the user. Units: About 80,000.

title: Engineered Controls International Recalls LP Gas Compact Regulators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The regulators could leak gas, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,300.

title: Lectric Ebikes Recalls Disc Brake Calipers Sold on Lectric E-Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The mechanical disc brake calipers located on the front and rear of the e-bike can fail resulting in loss of control, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 45,000.

title: Pirelli Tire Recalls P ZERO Race TLR Bicycle Tires Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The tire bead can unseat from the rim and lead to rapid air loss in the tires, resulting in loss of control and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 14,500 (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada).

title: Whirlpool Recalls Stacked Commercial Clothes Dryers Sold Under the ADC Brand Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled clothes dryers can overheat and ignite the clothes load, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: DR Power Equipment Recalls DR Power Chipper Shredders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Pieces of metal can come loose from inside the shredder's housing and be ejected, posing a laceration hazard. Also, the hopper can become detached from the shredder, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 5,900 (In addition, about 90 were sold in Canada).

title: FXI Recalls Novaform ComfortGrande and DreamAway Mattresses Due to Risk of Mold Exposure; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattresses could have been exposed to water during the manufacturing process allowing mold to develop and posing a health risk to individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 48,000.

title: H&M Recalls Men's Clasp Beaded Bracelets Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard; High Levels of Lead Content
summary: The clasp on the beaded bracelet contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 12,290.

title: HONEY JOY Recalls Infant Swings Due to Suffocation Hazard and Violation of Federal Safety Standards; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The swing violates the Safe Sleep for Babies Act because the product was marketed for infant sleep and has an incline angle greater than 10 degrees. Infant fatalities have occurred in inclined sleepers, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under ot

title: Make Believe Ideas Recalls Seven Rainbow Road Board Books Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic binding rings can detach from the books, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 260,000 (In addition, about 12,900 in Canada).

title: Shimano Recalls Cranksets for Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The recalled bonded crank parts can separate and break, posing a crash hazard to consumers. Units: About 680,000 (In addition, 80,000 were sold in Canada).

title: American Honda Motor Recalls Lawnmowers and Pressure Washer Engines Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The improperly manufactured camshafts in the engines can cause the starter rope to suddenly retract when pulling to start, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 391,800.

title: Best Buy Recalls Insignia and Yardbird Fire Tables with Lava Rocks Due to Burn and Impact Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The lava rocks can split and eject from the fire table, posing burn and impact injury hazards. Units: About 1,490.

title: Buffalo Games Recalls Chuckle & Roar Ultimate Water Beads Activity Kits Due to Serious Ingestion, Choking and Obstruction Hazards; One Infant Death Reported; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: If a water bead is ingested, it expands and can pose ingestion, choking and intestinal obstruction hazards inside a child's body, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and a risk of death to a child. Units: About 52,000.

title: Generac Recalls Portable Generators Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled generators' fuel tank can fail to vent adequately from the rollover valve, causing the gas tank to build up excess pressure and expel fuel when opened, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 64,000.

title: STIHL Recalls MSA 300 Chain Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The chain saw can take longer to brake than expected, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,800.

title: TJX Recalls Foldable Bistro Set Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold at Marshalls, T.J. Maxx, HomeGoods and Homesense Stores
summary: The wooden frame of the chair can break or collapse when a consumer is seated in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 11,000.

title: Future Motion Recalls Onewheel Self-Balancing Electric Skateboards Due to Crash Hazard; Four Deaths Reported
summary: The skateboards can stop balancing the rider if the boards' limits are exceeded, posing a crash hazard that can result in serious injury or death. Units: 300000.

title: Nutraceutical Recalls Solaray Liposomal Multivitamins Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled dietary supplements contain iron, which must be in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child-resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 85,300.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles and Pro XD Utility Vehicles, Gravely ATLAS Utility Vehicles, and Bobcat Utility Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The passenger side seat belt buckle bracket was not properly welded, which could result in the seat belt anchor point separating from the frame, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 280 (In addition, 2 were sold in Canada).

title: Procter & Gamble Recalls Zevo Fly, Gnat and Fruit Fly Insect Spray Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: The aerosol containers can rupture and leak, posing injury and laceration hazards. Units: About 8,600.

title: Rust-Oleum Recalls Fluorescent Pink Spray Paint Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The can's spray valve assembly can detach with force, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 84,000.

title: Secura Recalls Air Fryers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: A wire connection in the air fryer can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 6,400 (In addition, about 680 were sold in Canada).

title: Trek Recalls Allant+ 7 Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The rear brake hose can kink and break when turning the handlebars, causing the rider to lose control of the bike, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 7,000.
